comparison.objective: Extract a connector terminal; record starts an engine by a rapid full-stroke pull while stabilizing it.
comparison.physical_skill: Millimetric tab access and coordinated tool-wire extraction versus high-speed, long-stroke pulling against reaction forces.
comparison.success_condition: Intact selective terminal removal versus a 30 cm pull within 0.5 s while engine displacement stays under 10 cm. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The record tests dynamic impulse and stabilization, not latch-mediated extraction.
